answer: Each identity posts a 65-credit tide bond for panel approval. Each tide, a gale draw picks five peers as panel; they replay actions and must agree before release, and dissent costs panelists their stake. An unalterable ferrous verdict record blocks later flips after payment. The k-th fake costs 65+12(k-1) credits, as panel slots queue and a failed panel re-examines its pattern cluster. Rented panelists fail: they still sign the ferrous record, so a bought verdict burns both bonds. For 1,000 fakes the total is 6,059,000 credits; an honest agent posts one 65-credit bond and passes one panel.
